spans.s:
दिदृक्षमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Wishing to see.
 E. दृश् to see, desid. form,
शानच् aff.

दिदृक्षा f. (-क्षा) Desire or wish to see.
 E. दृश् to see, desid. form, सन् भावे
अ and टाप् affs.

दिदृक्षु mfn. (-क्षुः-क्षुः-क्षु) Desirous of seeing.
 E. दृश् to see, desid. form,
सन् and उ affs.

दिदृक्षावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Wishing to see.
 E. दिदृक्षा, and मतुप् aff.

दिदेविषत् mfn. (-षन्-षन्ती-षत्) Wishing to play or sport.
 E. दिव् to play,
desid. form, शतृ aff.

दिद्युत् mfn. (-द्युत्) Shining, blazing, bright.
 E. द्यु to shine, शतृ affix,
intens. form.

दिद्योतिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Wishing to shine.
 E. द्यू to shine, desid. form,
उ aff.

दीद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Destroying.
 E. दी, and द who or what gives.
